## Magnifying Glass (haiku)
<br>

<!-- 9  words -->
Magnifying glass\
enlarges every detail.\
I am smaller now.\

`r end_poem_mark`

*Notes:*
This might lean a bit toward senryu more than haiku, but where does nature stop and human nature begin? Regarding form, the contest rules required lines with 5/7/5 syllables. Regarding meter, I'm a fan of haiku with alternating stresses: <b>&acute;</b>&nbsp;&breve;&nbsp;<b>&acute;</b>&nbsp;&breve;&nbsp;<b>&acute;</b> / &breve;&nbsp;<b>&acute;</b>&nbsp;&breve;&nbsp;<b>&acute;</b>&nbsp;&breve;&nbsp;<b>&acute;</b>&nbsp;&breve; /
